description: Defines the UserMigrationStatus class for tracking and reporting migration process details in SuiteCRM, including counters for processed, migrated, skipped, and error items, as well as handling detailed migration stats.

classes.name: UserMigrationStatus
classes.description: A class for tracking and reporting the status of user migration processes, including counters and detailed migration info.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns an array of UserMigrationStatsDetail objects representing detailed migration stats.

methods.name: isMigrated
methods.description: Checks if the migration process has been completed successfully without errors and not in dry run mode.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Indicates whether the current process is a dry run.

methods.name: setDryRun
methods.description: Sets the dry run mode for the migration process.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Adds a migration detail and updates counters based on the detail's type.

methods.name: getProcessed
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed items.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides a string summary of the migration status, including counters and details.
